378:t_014:0.en:
$$ミカ$$
「The robot army has been wiped out!」

378:t_014:1.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「So that army wasn't under $$ズール$$'s command after all...!?」

378:t_014:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「They were only puppets, in the end. Learn the power of my army of darkness with your own bodies!」

378:t_014:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「There are $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ mechs too!」

378:t_014:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Do you know something, $$グーラ$$!?」

378:t_014:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...We'll talk later. First, we take them down!」

378:t_014:7.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Fool, Demon Beast Prince! You carry the power of darkness within you, yet you challenge me!?」

378:t_014:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I... will live by my own will...!」

378:t_014:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Heh... He's really started speaking up, hasn't he?」

378:t_014:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, intercept the army of darkness.」

378:t_014:12.en:
$$葵$$
「Roger! This time we'll finish off those guys who crawled back up from the bottom of hell!」

378:t_014:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! Don't think you can do whatever you want with this Earth or the galaxy!」

378:t_015:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! We've destroyed your entire army!」

378:t_015:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Today was only a greeting, $$マーズ$$. And don't think this is the extent of my power.」

378:t_015:3.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「The power of darkness is gathering! If you people are going to welcome an age of the sun, then we will welcome an age of darkness!」

378:t_015:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Remember this! It is we who will fight the True War and save this universe!」

378:t_016:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Chasing them would be pointless, I suppose.」

378:t_016:1.en:
$$桂$$
「They'll come back on their own anyway. Even though we don't want to see them.」

378:t_016:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It's just as you guessed, $$正太郎$$. Father... the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is alive.」

378:t_016:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So it's not just $$皇帝ズール$$ - he survived too?」

378:t_016:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Just as $$ズール$$'s avatar said. The power of darkness is gathering in this world.」

378:t_016:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Most likely, it's because the collapse of the true universe, which comes once every 120 million years, is drawing near.」

378:t_016:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But if we defeat $$バアル$$, we can prevent that, right!?」

378:t_016:11.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Father said... that apart from the war between gods and demons, there is a battle that decides the fate of this universe...」

378:t_016:12.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I traveled all over the galaxy to look into it.」

378:t_016:15.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...To get it, the only way is to make contact with beings like Father or Emperor $$ズール$$.」

378:t_016:18.en:
$$グーラ$$
「If I find out anything, I'll let you know too.」

378:t_016:19.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll see each other again, right?」

378:t_016:20.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Who knows... Emperor $$ズール$$ and Father probably won't forgive me for turning on them.」

378:t_016:21.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then come with us! It's safer that way!」

378:t_017:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A perfect friend for $$正太郎$$, huh?」

378:t_017:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「H-hold on a second, $$クロウ$$!」

378:t_017:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't sweat it, $$ワッ太$$. You're a good friend to $$正太郎$$ in your own way.」

378:t_017:6.en:
$$タケル$$
($$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ were alive...)

378:t_017:7.en:
$$タケル$$
(The cold, dark gloom I felt... Is its true nature their power of darkness...?)

378:t_018:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「...It's no good... $$鉄人$$ is going to explode...」

378:t_019:0.en:
$$カイエン$$
「All right...! Down in one hit!」

378:t_019:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「It was $c's all-out blow, after all. This much is a piece of cake!」

378:t_020:0.en:
$$カイエン$$
「We couldn't put it down in one hit!」

378:t_020:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We have to hurry! Quit dawdling, we'll finish it with the next one!」

378:t_021:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those two make a good combination, don't they?」

378:t_021:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Well, sure. They're friends, after all.」

378:t_021:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Friends... I want to live together with $$正太郎$$ and the others, who taught me this warm feeling...)

378:t_021:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
(But to do that, I have to atone for what I did in the past.)

378:t_100:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is my precious friend! I'll never forgive you for trying to turn $$鉄人$$ into a demon!」

378:t_100:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! With our power, we'll defeat the bad guys!」

378:t_101:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! No matter how many times you come back, we will never bow to your darkness!」

378:t_101:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「I carry a promise to my brother in my heart! As long as I have it, I'll keep fighting alongside hope!」

378:t_102:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
(The power of darkness that keeps gathering...)

378:t_102:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Are you saying everything is moving toward its end...?)

kept_omissions: 378:t_014:10: Watta's あいつ (Gura) rendered 'He' (Gura is male per glossary); 378:t_016:1: Kei's 向こう rendered 'They' (Gestalt gender n/a; avoids he/she)
uncertain: 378:t_019:1: '$c、渾身の一撃だもの' - read $c as the subject ('It was $c's all-out blow'), could be a vocative
分身 (Xul's avatar) rendered 'avatar' - no settled term
真戦 rendered 'the True War' - no glossary entry
魔獣王子 rendered 'Demon Beast Prince' (plain English, no token)
暗黒の軍団 = 'army of darkness'; ロボット軍団 = 'robot army' (matches dlg_2051_00)
378:t_016:7: 皇帝ズール uses the existing token; あいつ = Space Demon King (from context)
